title: DID Management Set Agent Name — payload

mnemonic.description: The hosted DID slot the name is bound to.

name.description: The agent name's local part, without the leading `@` (the `alice` in `/@alice`). The hosting domain is taken from the DID, not this field.

didData.description: A new signed DID document whose `alsoKnownAs` claims the name. For `webvh`, a JSONL string containing the new log entry; for `web`, the DID document JSON. Published as a new version of the DID in the same commit as the name binding.

domain.description: Optional explicit hosting domain. When omitted, resolves via caller ACL default → system default. See category CONVENTIONS §1.

Response.title: DID Management Set Agent Name — response payload
